note: Model ids come from the providers' catalogs, but a catalog entry is not proof it is served: on 2026-10-30 several listed NVIDIA models answered 404 or timed out, so the defaults below were each run once with a real key. gpt-oss-20b with reasoning_effort low answers the routing prompt in about 3-10 s; the big Nemotron reasons at length and is kept for heavy work. ':free' OpenRouter models cost no credits but are rate-limited and have not been run yet. Override with EVENTMATE_NVIDIA_MODEL, EVENTMATE_NVIDIA_MODEL_LIGHT, EVENTMATE_OPENROUTER_MODEL_HEAVY, EVENTMATE_OPENROUTER_MODEL_LIGHT.
